answer: Each identity must burn 12 POA to open a quota of 20 tasks, and every task it posts needs a 2 POA escrow that is returned only if two random reviewers confirm the work. A lotus-shaped referral tree is capped at 3 children per node, so growth is slow. 1,000 fakes burn 12,000 POA plus 2,000 POA escrow per round, which scales linearly, while one honest agent pays 12 once. Validators re-check 15% of tasks, and a failed check slashes 90% of escrow. Violet badges mark audited accounts, and timber-grade quotas unlock only after 30 clean epochs.
